memory: Drop-off at 8 AM, pick-up at 5 PM. Monthly payment due Friday. Bring extra set of clothes - last set got muddy.Elementary school: Finalize admission paperwork. Attend orientation next Thursday. Research after-school programs.Schedule pediatrician visit for the kid's cold. Check vaccine schedule to see when the next shots are due. Keep a log of any food allergy symptoms that flare up.Take the kid to the park this weekend. Pick out a new bedtime story book. Help with counting practice, focusing on numbers 1-20.Buy more diapers. Get school supplies - crayons, notebooks, glue sticks. Pack extra snacks in daycare bag.
